s1.title: 1 · Virtual wallet
s1.body: Your coin balance sits in the top corner. These free coins have no monetary value. You start with a starting balance and can claim a daily reward.

s2.title: 2 · Games
s2.body: Open Games, read the rules first, then play. Every result is decided by the server, so it is fair for all players.

s3.title: 3 · Missions & achievements
s3.body: Complete relaxed missions for free coins and XP. There are no pressuring deadlines, and taking a break never penalises you.

s4.title: 4 · Healthy play
s4.body: Set reminders, a daily time limit, a cooldown, or take a break any time in Settings. It is entirely in your control.
